steps.content: With your body reclaimed, you are finally free from the pull of chaos, able to move on your own.
But you have no memories, no ability to think—you don't know where you're meant to go, only wandering aimlessly.
Until you come to a halt before a statue.
Soon, you realize it's not a statue but a woman standing still.
Having sensed your presence, the woman slowly opens her eyes, seeming to understand your predicament through a single glance.
Without warning, her solid form begins to crumble, flesh dissolving into dust to reveal a skeleton of forged steel beneath.
As the dust disperses, all that's left at the core of the steel structure is one withered heart.
When you pick up this last remnant of her being, the heart transforms into light once again and flows into your body.
Long-buried memories surge forth—you now remember who you are, recalling everything that has brought you here.
As you recover these memories that should never have been lost, you turn back, only to find the steel bones have corroded away. Nothing remains.
